description: This file defines the CountryDao class which handles database operations related to Country and Province entities, such as fetching lists and specific records by various criteria within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: CountryDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for Country and Province entities providing methods for retrieving geographic data from the database.

methods.name: getCountryList
methods.description: Retrieves the list of all countries ordered by name.

methods.name: getProvinceList
methods.description: Retrieves the list of provinces, optionally filtered by country code, ordered by province name.

methods.name: getCountryByCountryName
methods.description: Fetches a country entity based on its name.

methods.name: getCountryByCountryCode
methods.description: Fetches a country entity based on its country code.

methods.name: getProvinceByProvinceCode
methods.description: Fetches a province entity based on its province code.

methods.name: getProvinceByProvinceName
methods.description: Fetches a province entity based on its name.
